trajectory.text:
Available tools:
- linkedin_outreach_contacts: Automate Outreach on Linkedin with ease! Extract search results, Find LinkedIn profile URLs, Scrape LinkedIn profiles etc.. This API fetches the Linkedin URL and Name of the search you have made.
- browser_request: Make a request to any URL with a browser (renders Javascript)"

I need a vetting summary for Sarah Jenkins emailed to jordan.hires@techcorp.com, including her LinkedIn and portfolio details. Please search 3 pages deep for her profile and send the response copy to alex.recruiter@techcorp.com.

{
  "status": "success",
  "result": {
    "profile_url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarah-jenkins-84b291a/",
    "name": "Sarah Jenkins",
    "designation": "Senior Product Manager",
    "company": "TechCorp",
    "location": "San Francisco Bay Area",
    "search_depth": 3,
    "records_found": 1,
    "delivery_email": "alex.recruiter@techcorp.com",
    "request_id": "req_7k9m2n4p6q8r0s1t3v5x"
  }
}

The tool successfully retrieved Sarah Jenkins' LinkedIn profile details and confirmed the response delivery email. This provides the core professional data, though portfolio details are still needed to fulfill the request. Next, I will search for her portfolio link to complete the information set.
